artifacts.summary: Research report mapping all six deliverables (no-rewrite path list, identical-sides warning, resolve_move ambiguity, namespace-map scoping, report/exit-code gap, MODULE_RELOCATION.md) to concrete evidence in scripts/move-modules.py and the four archived task summaries (630, 632, 634, 635); corrects the docs/adr/** default path to docs/architecture/ADR-*.md; flags the missing scripts/ fixture-test infrastructure; identifies existing raw material for the relocation-method doc.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, scripts/move-modules.py's run() only returns non-zero on move_failures or a bare-form audit mismatch -- never when citation rewrites (classes 1-5,7) succeeded but move_trees() moved zero files. This exact gap was task 632's original bug (236 rewrites reported, 0 files moved, exit 0) and is still present in the tool as of task 644's research pass.

In BimodalLogic this repository's ADR directory is docs/architecture/ADR-*.md, not docs/adr/ -- docs/adr/ does not exist. Any future task description or default path list referencing 'docs/adr/**' is factually wrong for this repo and should be corrected to docs/architecture/ADR-*.md.

In BimodalLogic, no scripts/*.py file has any fixture-test or pytest infrastructure as of task 644's research. A future harness for scripts/move-modules.py (or similar scripts/*.py hardening) needs to build one from scratch, most naturally a disposable tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() git repo (move-modules.py refuses to run without .git present and shells out to `git mv`), with run(argparse.Namespace(...)) invoked in-process and stdout captured via contextlib.redirect_stdout for report-text assertions.
